headline: Saudi-led coalition destroys 2 ballistic missile launch platforms in Sanaa
dek: The Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed 2 ballistic missile launch platforms in Yemen's Sanaa on Monday morning, the latest strike in the Saudi-Ansar Allah front that has seen Riyadh airport partly reopen Sunday after a two-week shutdown while Ansar Allah attacks continued.
fault_line: Is the coalition degrading Ansar Allah launch capacity, or does every Sanaa strike buy another missile toward Riyadh?

sections.what_happened: The Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed 2 ballistic missile launch platforms in Yemen's Sanaa on Monday morning, the latest strike in the Saudi-Ansar Allah front that has seen Riyadh airport partly reopen Sunday after a two-week shutdown while Ansar Allah attacks continued.
sections.what_verified: Reuters-attributed live entries in JPost and Khaleej Times live blogs. Khaleej Times has NO declared tier in the source registry and is not counted toward corroboration; JPost's entry is 'By REUTERS', same family. Family count therefore 1 (Reuters), which is sufficient for a sig-2 item reported as an attributed coalition claim.
sections.what_disputed: No independent confirmation of the Sanaa damage in-window; Ansar Allah outlets have not confirmed this strike. The coalition's own Sunday interception claims (at least 10 ballistic missiles intercepted, via AFP/Dawn) and the Ansar Allah warning that Riyadh airport remains a 'military target' show the exchange is ongoing, not decided. Sunday's shrapnel injuries in Khamis Mushait/Ahad Rafidah were already recorded Oct 25 (1600-02/1700-01) and are not re-reported here.
sections.why_matters: While Riyadh's airport flies again, the coalition hits the launchers -- the war's second front, live.
sections.context: Background: Saudi-led coalition destroys 2 ballistic missile launch platforms in Sanaa

totw_analysis: Our read: While Riyadh's airport flies again, the coalition hits the launchers -- the war's second front, live. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is the coalition degrading Ansar Allah launch capacity, or does every Sanaa strike buy another missile toward Riyadh?
